fire: The patient had acute mitral regurgitation. On echocardiography, a torn leaflet was visible.
A thrombus prolapsed through the valve, causing right ventricular strain.
On transthoracic echocardiography, a mobile mass was attached to the aortic valve.
The man presented with pulmonary embolism, and echocardiography showed a dilated right ventricle.
A short-axis view demonstrated a large pericardial effusion.
Her echocardiogram revealed severe tricuspid valve stenosis.
On echocardiography, an atrial septal defect was noted in the child.
The left ventricle was dilated, with an ejection fraction of 20 percent on echocardiography.
quiet: The tourist had a long vacation. On Tuesday, a broken bicycle was repaired.
A mechanic pushed the cart through the gate, causing a small delay.
On weekend mornings, a small market is set up by the old bridge.
The man came in with his tax forms, and the clerk showed him a shorter form.
A wide-angle photo showed a large parking lot.
Her notebook listed several favorite restaurant menus.
On Fridays, a free concert is held in the park for children.
The back room was painted, with a price of 20 dollars per wall this year.
